description: This file contains utility functions and encoder mappings for converting Python objects, including Pydantic models and dataclasses, into JSON-compatible formats within the FastAPI framework.

methods.name: isoformat
methods.description: Converts a date or time object to its ISO 8601 string representation.

methods.name: decimal_encoder
methods.description: Encodes a Decimal as an int if no exponent, otherwise as a float.

methods.name: generate_encoders_by_class_tuples
methods.description: Creates a mapping from encoder functions to the types they handle.

methods.name: jsonable_encoder
methods.description: Recursively converts Python objects, including Pydantic models and dataclasses, into JSON-serializable formats, with support for custom encoders and filtering options.
